name: dev-hooks
description: Mick's Claude Code plugins: dev-workflow hooks, coding onboarding, thinking tools, and writing skills.

plugins.name: dev-hooks
plugins.description: Polyglot dev-workflow hooks (lint-on-edit, verification and reminder hooks, dangerous-command guard) plus the companion skills they point at (dev-env-setup, env-to-fnox, dockerfile, popovers-tooltips). See its plugin.json / README for the full list.

plugins.name: coding-onboarding
plugins.description: Onboarding for people new to coding or AI-assisted coding: getting-started (idempotent machine setup) and starting-a-project (stack decision tree with scaffold commands and deploy targets).

plugins.name: thinking-tools
plugins.description: Adversarial critique and self-checking skills: board, premortem, but-for-real, self-rate, code-simplifier, weekly-automation-review, commit-digest.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Writing and content skills adapted from Nate Berkopec's dotfiles: github-readme, humanizer, readability.
